maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new agricultural, construction and turf equipment sales through dealers; parts and service are a smaller share.

publicly_funded.reason: Buyers are mainly farmers, contractors and consumers paying privately; government is a minor customer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own tractor, combine and construction machinery and technology; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Farm machinery tied to dealer networks, Operations Center data and precision-ag tech; switching means retraining, data and fleet disruption.
